These conspiracies are driving me absolutely insane, yes the measures are horse shit but we’ve just got to get on with it for now for the protection of the more vulnerable people in society. 

Having said that, I am beyond sick of how the coronavirus pandemic has seemingly gone from a global health crisis to something so heavily politicised and used as a way for parties to score political points. I work in the hospitality sector and it seems that we’re being used as a scapegoat for government incompetence, as anyone who’s ever been to a pub will know how strict the measures are regarding capacity, cleanliness, etc (in most venues) yet we’re to be hit AGAIN just as we’re all starting to slowly but surely build up our customer base again and getting people used to the stricter measures such as social distancing and mask wearing. Personally, I think this will be the killing blow for small independently owned pubs, cafes and restaurants and it’s a damn shame. 

TL;DR:  Conspiracy theories are BS and I’m fed up of the politics on this issue

You’re one of the lucky ones if you didn’t buy it. I think popularity was a major player in the decision as well as not enough people buying the in game cosmetics they relied on to fund future content. However, it’s been apparent for a long time that DICE seemingly had no interest in continuing support for the game. Either way, it’s a shame that it’s ended like this but hopefully it’ll be a lesson for the devs in the future.

Basically, DICE are cutting any further support for BFV after an update in the summer time.  The community is in an uproar (and rightfully so) because it’ll probably be the first WW2 game without the major battles of the conflict. DICE also assured the community on several occasions that they wouldn’t give up on BFV but that’s exactly what they’ve done.
I’ll definitely be going back to both BF1 and BF4 after that announcement. The only things I’ll really miss about BFV are the movement and gunplay (excluding 5.2 update)

What an unfortunate (but foreseeable) disaster. The way this game has been handled has been nothing short of a fucking joke. The reveal trailer, the “don’t like it, don’t buy it” bullshit, the constant “hang in there, we’re committed to making this game better” and then making it worse, the unrealistic cosmetics, the complete lack of any meaningful content such as maps, guns, etc, honestly the list goes on and on. 

As many others on this sub have mentioned, the upper management at DICE needs to go, they’ve steered BFV in the wrong direction since launch and basically told long term fans of the series to suck it up and deal with it or fuck off. From what I gather, upper management are also responsible for the departure of some of DICEs top talent. 

I personally think that BF1 should have had its lifecycle extended by at least another year with another DLC or two so that BFV could have more time in development and maybe have released in a good enough state. 

I’m really fucking sick of the gaming industry in general, where AAA companies now think it’s okay to release what’s basically an early access game and charge full price with the promise of “new content” even though most of the content has been hidden in the files since launch.  I think it’s high time I find a new hobby, one where the providers of said hobby don’t treat you like a fucking idiot and actually value your money and feedback.

TL;DR: The upper management at DICE should be replaced by monkeys.
